svg.title: Workplace meeting: transcript to board, question to suggestion, catch me up, minutes

g.text: Workplace meeting: transcript to board, question to suggestion, catch me up, minutes
1. Transcript to the board (every FINAL segment, in workplace mode)
Interview-only steps are skipped here: no integrity
hooks, no turn timer, no follow-up generation.
the board is replaced as a whole;
the overlay ignores it (board is in the main window)
2. Question to the user: suggested answer (only when addressed to you)
(a colleague answering a colleague, not an interview answer).
any question on the board can be asked this way,
including ones not addressed to the user
3. Catch me up (on demand, live workplace meeting only)
4. Meeting end: minutes, then store and export
